author: Jerseys
body:
Hello,

Yesterday, I was banned for 'Ddos Threats' I did not threaten anyone on ts, I just wrote 'ill ddos ur nan m8' Everyone in the team-peak were like 'DDOS DDOS DDOS' as a joke, every moderator knows I do these kind of things, I know its my own fault, but its the Omega Update and I just want to play with my friends.

It's just a shame, I really regret what I said if I hurt anyone in any kind of shape, but it was all a joke, i know DDosing is suppose to be taken as a joke however when I said, it was suppose to be funny. But it wasn't, I will never ever say it again.

Sometime I can be very stupid, I need to be more aware of the thing I state. I need to think before I act.

Thank you,

Dynamo

title: Second Appeal Of My Team Speak Infraction

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

I feel that this punishment was un-just and i will appeal this for you.

Try to not mention DDos'ing people in the future. 

To appeal you i need your ip to correct the ban.
